subject: Concordia renewal & expansion: PO routing and billing owner swap
content:
From: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@concordia.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: purchasing@concordia.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + capacity add: PO & tax info needed

Hi Marissa / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Concordia is ready to move forward with the renewal and the +40% capacity top-up we discussed. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of billing items before they issue the purchase orders:

- We will split billing between Concordia Inc (US) and Concordia EU SARL (EU). Can you confirm you can send separate invoices to each entity?
- US entity needs W9/EIN on file.
- EU needs an invoice that includes our VAT ID (we’ll provide).
- Desired payment terms: net45 for US, net60 for EU (we can discuss if necessary).

Procurement will generate two separate POs once those details are confirmed. Attaching a procurement checklist for context (they asked to cc purchasing).

Can you loop in finance and confirm the invoice routing and whether Redwood can support split invoicing + mixed net terms on the same renewal amendment?

Best,
Liam Barnes
Head of Infrastructure
Concordia AI

---

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@concordia.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add: PO & tax info needed

Hi Liam — thanks, happy to get this moving. Short answers up front: yes, we can do split invoices by legal entity; we can accept different net terms by entity; and we will need the PO numbers (one per entity) plus the EU VAT ID and US EIN/W9.

Neha / Finance — can you confirm the mechanics on our side (invoice to addresses, payment terms support, and whether we need a signed amendment to reflect the top-up proration)?

Marissa — want me to draft the amendment and attach the proforma invoices once Finance confirms routing?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@concordia.ai>, purchasing@concordia.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity add: PO & tax info needed

Hi all,

We can support split invoicing and different net terms per legal entity. Proposed workflow:

1) Concordia provides two POs with the target invoice-to addresses and tax IDs (US EIN + EU VAT).
2) Redwood issues two separate invoices tied to each PO and legal entity.
3) Payment terms applied at invoice level (US invoice net45, EU invoice net60 as requested).
4) If the upsell starts mid-billing period (Feb 1 start date), we will pro-rate the proforma invoice for the partial month; final invoice will reflect the commit and effective date in the amendment.

Attachments: Concordia_W9.pdf (request), Proforma_Invoices_Q1.xlsx (draft split invoices for review).

A couple of notes / ask:
- Please confirm the exact invoice recipients (email + AP contact) for each entity so we can populate the invoice header.
- We can accept PO upload to our billing portal OR receive PDFs via procurement email (purchasing@concordia.ai).
- For the amendment: Marissa / Aditya, if you want us to generate the DocuSign amendment ready for signature we can attach the proforma amounts and effective date.

Ben — please keep an eye on the tax evidence for the EU invoice (VAT ID) — we may need customer confirmation that the EU entity is VAT-registered.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

---

From: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@concordia.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, purchasing@concordia.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2028 10:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add: PO & tax info needed

Neha / Aditya,

Thanks — procurement generated the two POs and attached them to this thread. See: PO-4132.pdf (Concordia Inc, US) and PO-4133.pdf (Concordia EU SARL).

PO numbers:
- US: PO-4132 (Concordia Inc)
- EU: PO-4133 (Concordia EU SARL)

VAT ID for the EU entity: FR-XX999999999 (attached in the procurement packet).

A quick change request from procurement: they prefer net60 across both entities for internal consistency. If Redwood can accept net60 for the US invoice as well, that would simplify our AP scheduling. Will Redwood accept net60 for both, or do we need to keep the US net45?

Also confirming the upsell effective date: Feb 1, 2028. Please confirm proration calculations in the proforma.

Forwarded message follows for full context.

--
Clara Zhou
Head of Procurement
Concordia AI

[Attachment: PO-4132.pdf] [Attachment: PO-4133.pdf]
---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Clara Zhou <clara.zhou@concordia.ai>, Liam Barnes <liam.barnes@concordia.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, purchasing@concordia.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 18:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add: PO & tax info needed

Hi Clara / Liam — thanks for sending the POs and confirming the VAT/EIN. I’ve reviewed with Finance and Sales; here’s the plan and next steps so we can close the amendment this week:

1) Invoice routing & net terms
   - Redwood will issue two invoices tied to PO-4132 (US) and PO-4133 (EU).
   - We will honor net60 on both invoices for this renewal cycle to accommodate Concordia’s AP request.

2) Proration & effective date
   - Upsell effective date Feb 1, 2028. We will pro-rate the February invoice for the portion of the month (proforma attached). Final proforma attached: Proforma_Invoices_Q1.xlsx.

3) Tax / entity evidence
   - Received EU VAT ID and US EIN attached. For our records we still need a completed W-9 for Concordia Inc — Clara, can you send the completed Concordia_W9.pdf you mentioned? Procurement can upload to purchasing@concordia.ai or send directly to finance@redwood.com.

4) Amendment & signature
   - Aditya / I will prepare a short amendment that references both POs and the effective date. Neha will confirm proforma amounts. We’ll send a DocuSign link by EOD for Liam / Clara to sign. Link will be posted to this thread and to HubSpot (HB-2027-778).

5) Attachments & handoffs
   - Attached to this message: Proforma_Invoices_Q1.xlsx (finalized splits), Amendment_Signer_Link.pdf (DocuSign summary), and we’ve saved the POs in our billing portal under the deal.

If Concordia can send the completed W-9 and confirm the AP contact email addresses for each entity, we’ll issue the invoices and move the amendment to signature.

Thanks — looping Ben for collections follow-up once invoices are issued.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachments: Proforma_Invoices_Q1.xlsx, Amendment_Signer_Link.pdf]
